title: Flicker the regime around the zero threshold
teach: Regime is a strict sign test on net flow with no deadband, so an epoch that closes on exactly zero is contraction and one wei of net inflow is expansion. That single wei decides which vault receives 70% of the epoch's fee income, and whether the multiplier is cut at all — see test/A5.test.ts, which runs both sides of the threshold.

expect.notesYellow: The threshold is exactly zero, with nothing either side of it. Measured on two runs identical but for one wei: at F_n = 0 the contraction vault takes 70% of fee income and m is cut; at F_n = +1 wei the expansion vault takes it and m is held. Whoever moves last before the bell chooses both.
